pool.text: Tsar Boris Godunov issued a decree establishing the city of Tomsk.
The Imperial Russian government selected Tomsk as the seat of the new governorate.
The discovery of gold brought further development to Tomsk.
Tomsk Polytechnic University was founded in the Siberian city.
Power station TEC-1 was launched in Tomsk.
The main line of the Trans-Siberian railway was built.
Factories were relocated out of the war zone into Tomsk.
Power station GRES-2 was launched in the city.
Five tram lines were constructed in the city of Tomsk.
A secret city known as Tomsk-7 was established.
The settlement of Tomsk-7 received municipal status.
The Tomsk Railway existed as an independent entity until this year.
Eight trolleybus lines were built in the city.
Power station TEC-3 was launched in Tomsk.
Tomsk-7 was renamed Seversk.
The local football team achieved promotion to the Russian Premier League.
Local elections took place where the Pensioners Party put up a strong showing.
Tomsk received international media attention as the venue of a major summit.
Ivan Klyayn, a member of The United Russia party, was appointed mayor.
The airport located 20 kilometers from the city center was renovated.
